text:
maria_cs: Heads up — AtlasPay QBR scheduled in two weeks. Need final slide owners, a short health snapshot, and a focused note on renewal risk. I ran an activation-lag heatmap this morning and want it included in the ops slide.

devon_csm: Thanks Maria. Activation lag = time from signup -> first successful API call, right? Do you have cohort breakdowns?

maria_cs: Yep. Quick summary below. Biggest drop is in cohort 0-7 days for EU customers after onboarding email change.

maria_cs: ```
cohort | median lag (hrs) | failed-first-call %
0-7d   | 18               | 24%
8-30d  | 6                | 8%
31+d   | 2                | 3%
```

ashley_enablement: Yikes — 24% failed-first-call is a clear enablement ask. I can draft an updated quickstart + checklist for onboarding emails. Who owns slide for onboarding play?

sam_platform: I can take the tech slide. There are two probable root causes: 1) rate-limit config changed in eu-prod last month; 2) smaller clients hitting new auth edge-case. I can run a canary on auth fallback this week.

jordan_rev: Renewal signal flagged: AtlasPay's monthly active tenants down 12% last 30 days, correlated with activation lag. Exec wants a one-slide risk summary + proposed mitigation (eng + enablement).

maria_cs: Good. Slide map proposal:
- Ops health (me) -> activation-lag heatmap + short notes
- Tech mitigation (sam) -> rate-limit fix + canary plan
- Enablement play (ashley) -> email + quickstart + support script
- Exec ask & renewal impact (jordan) -> revenue risk + proposed cadence

devon_csm: Can we add a customer quote/CSAT snippet? I have one repro ticket with logs we can anonymize.

ashley_enablement: I’ll draft the quickstart and a short 3-bullet battleground for CSMs (what to say, what to escalate, how to measure). Target share by EOD Thurs.

sam_platform: Canary plan: enable auth-fallback for 10% EU traffic; monitor failed-first-call and request latency for 72h. If metrics improve, promote and update rate-limit template. Target to start Fri morning.

maria_cs: Action items (assign owners + due dates):
1) Produce activation-lag heatmap slide (maria_cs) — due Tue EOD
2) Tech canary plan + slide (sam_platform) — start Fri, slide due Tue EOD
3) Enablement quickstart + CSM cue cards (ashley_enablement) — draft due Thurs EOD
4) Anonymized customer example + CSAT snippet (devon_csm) — due Mon
5) One-slide renewal risk + ask for execs (jordan_rev) — due Tue EOD
6) QBR deck assemble + dry-run scheduling (maria_cs + chris_qbrbot) — deck by Tue noon, dry-run Wed

jordan_rev: Suggest we add a fallback pricing concession option in the exec ask in case engagement doesn't recover by end of quarter. I can draft language.

devon_csm: Noted. I’ll also pull feature adoption by plan tier to show where usage dropped.

chris_qbrbot: Reminder scheduled: QBR dry-run in #customer-success on 3887720000. :bell:

maria_cs: Perfect. Quick checks: keep slides to 1-2 bullets each, include one data viz (heatmap) and one clear CTA per slide. If you can't meet due date, ping me ASAP.

ashley_enablement: Aiming to have CSM playbook + support script in a single Google doc. Will @maria_cs when ready. :white_check_mark:

sam_platform: Will post canary run logs in this thread and tag devon for ticket correlation.

devon_csm: Thanks. If anyone needs sample wording for customer outreach, lemme know — I'll share a short template.

maria_cs: Closing note: treat this as a high-risk renewal. Execs want a compact mitigation plan and a clear ask (timeline + metric).

reminder-bot: Automated reminder: slide owners deliverables due 3887740000.

maria_cs: Thanks team — I'll assemble the deck skeleton after I get your slides and send the dry-run invite.
